Name: Horse Elliott (CP portrait mod)
Author: jerryriganims
Description:
get your grotesque fleshy stallion boyfriend Elliott today!

This mod all started as a joke sprite edit i made for one reason only, to send it to an Elliott ask blog on tumblr. then i made the rest of the base portraits, cuz it would be fun to draw the expressions, then the winter portraits, the beach portraits, then at that point i was in too deep so i just made the whole sprite sheets, did some bullsh*t notepad edits and thanks to the grace of content patcher, my wild horse boy Elliott dreams have galloped into life.

[] HOW TO DOWNLOAD []
download the file, unzip it and put the contents into your Stardew mods folder.
